properties.description: The screen every forwarding loop in proxy.rs puts in front of a --read-only session (--remote, --shared, a client attached through .reflow2.toml). A tools/call leaves only when this build's served surface, the server's own tools/list and the file rule (service::FILE_WRITING_TOOLS with path) all say it reads; a call it cannot classify is refused as a write, as an MCP tool error naming --read-only, and nothing is sent. Non-read methods are refused by name; lines are forwarded re-serialised from the value that was judged; a non-JSON line and a batch carrying a refused call are not sent.
properties.name: read_only_client.rs — a --read-only CLIENT screens every line before it is sent
